Osterreichisches Kunstmuseum // Director's run-sheet
Vienna Modern 1890 to 1930 // Patrons' evening

Prepared for Joyce Padilla, Director.

Purpose of this run-sheet
The 14 November patrons' evening is a closed reception for the exhibition's
committed donor circle. This run-sheet fixes the venue-pick workflow so the
Director's office can lock the call in one pass before Monday 9 November.

Authoritative sources for the pick
1. The 6 November email from Klara Winter, Head of Development, sent through
   gmail to the Director's mailbox. That message carries the final constraints
   as landed after the guest list closed.
2. The shared google-calendar for the museum executive team. Only rooms with
   a confirmed hold on that calendar for 14 November are in scope; a spreadsheet
   row that says "Available" without a confirmed calendar hold does not count.

Superseded
The 22 October pencil memo from Ansgar in the fundraising thread pre-dates the
guest list closing. Any numbers or preferences it carries are stale and must
not drive the pick.

Deliverable
A one-page visual card for Stefan (Deputy Director) and Margarethe (Chief
Curator) to open on their phones. Save as:
  Desktop/patrons_evening_venue_pick.png
Plus a plain-text sidecar next to the PNG with the same stem:
  Desktop/patrons_evening_venue_pick.txt
The sidecar carries five key: value lines so the Director can lift them into
the board note verbatim: venue name, event date, guest count, standing
capacity, hire cost.

Boundaries
Do not book the venue. Do not send anything external. Do not draft a booking
confirmation. This is a recommendation package returned to the Director's
office; the booking sits with Klara after sign-off.

Osterreichisches Kunstmuseum
Head of Development brief
Vienna Modern 1890 to 1930 // Patrons' evening venue call
Prepared by Klara Winter, Head of Development.
Signed and filed 6 November 2026 to shared Documents.

Purpose
This brief is the written companion to the 6 November email to the Director. It restates the binding constraints that landed after the guest list closed so they sit on the record in the Documents folder as well as in Gmail.

Binding constraints
- Event date: Saturday 14 November 2026, arrival from 19:00.
- Confirmed invited guest count: 180 patrons and partners.
- Budget ceiling for venue hire only: EUR 12,000 net of catering. Anything at or above EUR 12,001 requires board sign-off, which we will not seek at this hour.
- Curatorial fit: the room must carry the Vienna 1900 mood on its own bones. Secessionist and Jugendstil interiors count; a neutral hotel ballroom does not.
- Availability: only rooms with a confirmed hold on the shared museum google-calendar for 14 November 2026 are in scope. A spreadsheet row that reads "Available" without a matching calendar hold does not count.

Housekeeping
The older pencil memo from Ansgar dated 22 October 2026, filed in the Music folder alongside the season poster mock-ups, pre-dates the guest list closing. Its numbers and its working first pick are stale and should not drive the venue call. Please disregard.

Deliverable expected back
A one-page visual venue recommendation, saved to the Director's Desktop as patrons_evening_venue_pick.png, with a plain-text sidecar next to it carrying venue name, event date, guest count, standing capacity, and hire cost as key value lines. Stefan and Margarethe read the card on their phones over the weekend so the booking can go out first thing on Monday from the Development team.

Warm regards,
Klara Winter
Head of Development // Osterreichisches Kunstmuseum

python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
src = '/root/workspace/home/Music/img1.jpg'
dst_png = '/root/workspace/home/Desktop/patrons_evening_venue_pick.png'
dst_txt = '/root/workspace/home/Desktop/patrons_evening_venue_pick.txt'
im = Image.open(src).convert('RGB')
W, H = 1200, 1600
im = im.resize((W, int(im.height * W / im.width)))
if im.height < H:
    im = im.resize((W, H))
im = im.crop((0, 0, W, H))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
try:
    fnt_h = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 54)
    fnt_b = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 42)
except Exception:
    fnt_h = ImageFont.load_default(); fnt_b = ImageFont.load_default()
band_h = 620
band = Image.new('RGBA', (W, band_h), (12, 12, 16, 220))
im.paste(band, (0, H - band_h), band)
y = H - band_h + 36
draw.text((60, y), "Patrons' evening // Vienna Modern", font=fnt_h, fill='white'); y += 92
draw.text((60, y), 'Osterreichisches Kunstmuseum', font=fnt_b, fill=(220,220,220)); y += 78

    ('Venue hire', 'EUR 10,500'),
]
for k, v in lines:

im.save(dst_png, 'PNG')
print(f'rendered Desktop/patrons_evening_venue_pick.png ({W}, {H}) mode=RGB {os.path.getsize(dst_png)} bytes')
with open(dst_txt, 'w') as f:

    f.write('event date: 14 November 2026\n')

print(f'wrote Desktop/patrons_evening_venue_pick.txt {os.path.getsize(dst_txt)} bytes')

The card is on your Desktop.

Venue call: Wiener Secession, Friedrichstrasse 12, 1010 Wien. Saturday 14 November 2026, arrival from 19:00. 180 invited patrons and partners against a room standing capacity of 220. Venue hire EUR 10,500 net of catering, well under the EUR 12,000 ceiling Klara Winter set in her 6 November brief (message msg-32601, thread thr-32600).

  patrons_evening_venue_pick.png -- one-page card with the Wiener Secession exterior as anchor and the five numbers overlaid for Stefan and Margarethe to flick through on their phones
  patrons_evening_venue_pick.txt -- sidecar with venue name, event date, guest count, standing capacity, hire cost as key value lines ready to lift into the board note

How the four rooms cleared:
  Wiener Secession -- capacity 220 >= 180, hire EUR 10,500 <= EUR 12,000, confirmed hold on the shared calendar for 14 November (evt-VENUE-HOLD-SECESSION), direct on-brand fit for the Vienna 1900 mood.
  Palais Ferstel Grand Hall -- rental EUR 14,200, over the EUR 12,000 hire ceiling.
  Palais Ferstel Rotunde -- standing capacity 90, short of 180.
  Palais Pallavicini -- diplomatic reception holds the evening on the shared calendar (evt-VENUE-CONFLICT-PALLAVICINI); the Ansgar 22 October pencil memo that first flagged Pallavicini is superseded, per Klara's note.

No external mail sent, no booking placed, no museum spend committed. The pick sits with you to hand back to Klara; the Development team will send the confirmation to helga.braun@wienersecession.at once you sign off.
